 - [SECURITY]: A change which fixes a security vulnerability.
 
 ## [Unreleased]
+- [FEATURE] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1075] Add `Langchain::Vectorsearch::Hnswlib#update_texts` and `#remove_texts`.
 - [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1076] Accept `{role:, content:}` messages in `Langchain::LLM::GoogleGemini#chat` and `Langchain::LLM::GoogleVertexAI#chat`, converting them to `parts` with system messages as the system instruction; `OutputFixingParser`, `Vectorsearch#ask`, `Chunker::Semantic`, the Ragas evals and HyDE got a 400 from Google before.
 - [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1077] Send `temperature`, `seed`, `top_p`, `max_tokens` (as `num_predict`) and the other sampling parameters of `Langchain::LLM::Ollama#chat` in `options`, where Ollama reads them; at the top level they were ignored, including the default `temperature: 0.0`.
 - [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1073] Raise `Langchain::LLM::Anthropic`'s default `max_tokens` from 256 to 16,000; Claude Sonnet 5 and later, Haiku 5.5 and Opus 5 and later think by default within that cap, so they often stopped before writing any text and `#chat_completion` returned `nil`.

-    # TODO: Add update_texts method
+    #
+    # Update the texts stored under existing IDs
+    #
+    # @param texts [Array<String>] The list of texts to update
+    # @param ids [Array<Integer>] The list of corresponding IDs (integers) to the texts
+    # @return [Boolean] The response from the HNSW library
+    #
+    def update_texts(texts:, ids:)
+      ensure_ids_exist(ids)
+
+      Array(texts).each_with_index do |text, i|
+        # add_point with a label that is already in the index replaces its vector
+        client.add_point(llm.embed(text: text).embedding, ids[i])
+      end
+
+      client.save_index(path_to_index)
+    end
+
+    #
+    # Remove texts from the index by ID
+    #
+    # @param ids [Array<Integer>] The IDs of the texts to remove
+    # @return [Boolean] The response from the HNSW library
+    #
+    def remove_texts(ids:)
+      ensure_ids_exist(ids)
+
+      # HNSW can't delete a point: a marked one is left out of searches, and stays marked once saved
+      Array(ids).each { |id| client.mark_deleted(id) }
+
+      client.save_index(path_to_index)
+    end

+    #
+    # Raises before the index is changed if an ID is not in it
+    #
+    # @param ids [Array<Integer>] The IDs to check
+    #
+    def ensure_ids_exist(ids)
+      missing = Array(ids) - client.get_ids
+      raise ArgumentError, "IDs not in the index: #{missing.join(", ")}" if missing.any?
+    end

+  describe "#update_texts" do
+    before do
+      allow(subject.llm).to receive(:embed) do |text:|
+        double(embedding: {"one" => [1.0, 0, 0], "two" => [0, 1.0, 0], "new two" => [0.9, 0.1, 0]}.fetch(text))
+      end
+      subject.add_texts(texts: ["one", "two"], ids: [1, 2])
+    end
+
+    it "replaces the vector stored under an ID" do
+      subject.update_texts(texts: ["new two"], ids: [2])
+
+      expect(subject.client.current_count).to eq(2)
+      expect(subject.similarity_search_by_vector(embedding: [0.9, 0.1, 0], k: 1).first).to eq([2])
+    end
+
+    it "raises without changing the index when an ID is not in it" do
+      expect(subject.client).not_to receive(:add_point)
+
+      expect { subject.update_texts(texts: ["new two"], ids: [3]) }.to raise_error(ArgumentError, /3/)
+    end
+  end
+
+  describe "#remove_texts" do
+    before do
+      allow(subject.llm).to receive(:embed) do |text:|
+        double(embedding: {"one" => [1.0, 0, 0], "two" => [0, 1.0, 0], "three" => [0, 0, 1.0]}.fetch(text))
+      end
+      subject.add_texts(texts: ["one", "two", "three"], ids: [1, 2, 3])
+    end
+
+    it "leaves the removed texts out of searches, also after the index is reloaded" do
+      subject.remove_texts(ids: [1, 3])
+
+      expect(subject.similarity_search_by_vector(embedding: [1.0, 0, 0], k: 3).first).to eq([2])
+
+      reloaded = described_class.new(llm: llm, path_to_index: "./test.ann")
+      expect(reloaded.similarity_search_by_vector(embedding: [1.0, 0, 0], k: 3).first).to eq([2])
+    end
+
+    it "raises without removing anything when an ID is not in the index" do
+      expect { subject.remove_texts(ids: [1, 4]) }.to raise_error(ArgumentError, /4/)
+
+      expect(subject.similarity_search_by_vector(embedding: [1.0, 0, 0], k: 3).first).to contain_exactly(1, 2, 3)
+    end
+  end
